lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Ileana, it's Camila from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the overnight fast went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good! I didn't miss a day.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You feel like you have to do something.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Beans count too, and they keep you full.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Everybody gets home late, so dinner is late.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Dinner's late at your house.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I bought spinach and actually used it. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the overnight fast. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've already started.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My family eats late, like at 9, and I'm not going to eat alone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not sure it's worth it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, my health is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 5 days next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was the parties, and next week you're going to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 5 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

flags.reason: Goal set directly ('Let's put you down') right after participant's hesitation, without asking or offering choice; undermines partnership.
Participant's hesitant 'I don't know' was not explored; coach moved straight to summary instead of asking what felt uncertain.

score.summary: Coach used many good reflections and affirmations that drew out the participant's strong change talk around family, health, and grandchildren. However, the new goal was assigned directly after the participant hesitated, and the barrier of late family dinners was not planned for.
strengths: Line 16 and 23: affirms her knowledge of her schedule and returns control of the plan to her.
Line 32 and 38: complex reflections that link the change to getting her life back and seeing small changes add up.
Line 45: clear summary that checks for anything missed before closing.
coaching_tips: Line 43: before setting the goal, ask permission or offer options, e.g., 'Would it help to pick one vegetable we could start with?'
Line 44: explore the 'I don't know' with an open question such as 'What feels uncertain about that?' before moving on.
Line 35 and 25: late family dinners were a clear barrier; ask 'What could you do when dinner is at 9?' to plan for it.
